items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: I used to like old man Contra. The best.

ctx.x: Can you tell us who your favorite drummers are, or were in the old days? Did you get, I guess you were busy most of the time and didn't get to hear many of the other bands. Which ones did you like when you heard them?
I used to like old man Contra. The best.
Where did you hear him, whose band was he with when you heard it?
